start.title: Apply to universities in Turkey, with no service fee
start.text: The university pays our service fee, not you. Just send your documents and, once they're approved, sign the pledge.

upload.title: Upload your documents
upload.text: The list depends on your degree.

review.title: Our team reviews them
review.text: Something missing? We tell you what and why.

sign.title: Sign the pledge
sign.text: Right here in the panel, with an SMS code.

start.formText: So we can show the documents you need.
start.error: Not saved. Check your internet connection and try again.

docs.title: Upload your documents for Turkey
docs.subtitle: The list below is for a {{degree}} degree.
docs.label: Documents for Turkey
docs.tooBig: This file is {{size}}. The limit is {{max}}.
docs.badType: This file type isn't accepted. Choose a PDF, or a JPG or PNG photo.
docs.footer: Once you send them, our team reviews your documents and lets you know by SMS.
docs.reviewFooter: Once every document is approved, the pledge appears in your panel.
docs.submitError: Not sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
docs.waiting: Our team is reviewing them. We'll let you know by SMS.

sign.title: Pledge for the free Turkey application
sign.text: Read it and sign with an SMS code. Your case starts as soon as you sign.
sign.accept: I've read the pledge and accept it.
sign.acceptFirst: First confirm you've read the text.
sign.sendError: The code wasn't sent. Try again in a moment.
sign.codeIncomplete: Enter all {{length}} digits of the code.
sign.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Try again or get a new code.
sign.error: Not signed. Check your internet connection and try again.
sign.record: The time of signing, your phone number and the text's version are kept in your case.

done.title: Your Turkey case has started
done.text: Your pledge is recorded and a copy is in “Contract & payment”. Your case supervisor will contact you soon and start applying to universities.

nextStep.apply: Suitable universities are suggested and applied to.
nextStep.approve: You see and approve every application in the panel.
